Problem: Find the Middle Node of a Singly Linked List
You are given N integers.
Create a Singly Linked List by inserting elements at the end.
Your task is to print the middle node value.
Important Rule
If the list has odd number of nodes → print the middle node.
If the list has even number of nodes → print the second middle node.
Input Format
N
a1 a2 a3 ... aN
N → number of elements
Next line contains N space-separated integers
Output Format
Print a single integer — the middle node value.
